geo.coord_source: Ministère de l'Éducation du Québec open-data layer 'Installation d'enseignement privé', updated 2026-10-26

description: Rare Montessori secondary school (Secondary 1–5) in the Eastern Townships, paired with École Montessori Magog (preschool–elementary). Multi-level classes of at most 24, instruction in French and English according to the student's mother tongue, forest-school and ski/music academies, an International Baccalaureate stream. Holds a teaching permit (RU.2838194 on the school site).

attributes.philosophy: Montessori approach at secondary level, multi-level context and small ratios (max 24) for learning at a personal pace.
